title: Data Caricatures: On the Representation of African American Language in Pretraining Corpora

bias_targets.methodology: Quantitative measurement of African American Language (AAL) prevalence in 12 pretraining corpora using a demographic alignment classifier and morphosyntactic feature analysis, complemented by human evaluation of text authenticity, stereotyping, and appropriateness, as well as an assessment of how 16 automated dataset filters disproportionately remove AAL compared to White Mainstream English (WME).

Evaluating the representation and stereotyping of Black culture and African American speakers by analyzing the prevalence of performative speech (e.g., n-gram overlap with hip-hop lyrics) and human annotations of harmful stereotypes, as well as comparing the data filtration rates between text associated with Black populations (AAL) and White populations (WME).
